marker_reviews.reason: The runtime RETURN QUERY EXECUTE builds only a SELECT over api.dam_order_list, using allowlisted quoted identifiers, fixed SQL operators, quoted literals and a bound search pattern. It ranks and returns existing rows without creating, altering or deleting a catalog object or application data. The function creation and authenticated-only grants are static statements, covered by the ordinary catalog/privilege verifier and SQL contract tests; this runtime SELECT introduces no additional durable catalog target.
